description: Complete single-player tactical mech combat game with voice-first accessibility, AI tactician, mission generator, and progression system
gameFlow: TITLE SCREEN -> NEW PILOT or CONTINUE -> PILOT QUARTERS (hub) -> MISSION SELECT -> MISSION BRIEFING -> COMBAT -> MISSION DEBRIEF -> PROGRESSION -> back to PILOT QUARTERS

epics.name: Core Game Flow
epics.description: Title screen, hub navigation, mission flow screens

epics.name: AI Tactician
epics.description: LLM-powered opponent that reasons about tactics and executes valid combat actions

epics.name: Voice Interface
epics.description: Speech-to-text input, voice intent parsing, text-to-speech feedback

epics.name: Mission Generator
epics.description: Procedural mission creation with LLM-generated narrative

epics.name: Accessibility Polish
epics.description: Canvas accessibility, screen reader support, reduced motion, keyboard shortcuts

userStories.title: Title Screen
userStories.description: Replace current dashboard with game title screen featuring New Pilot/Continue/Quick Battle/Settings buttons. This is the entry point for the entire game.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/` renders title screen instead of current dashboard
Displays game title 'LANCER TACTICS AI' and tagline
Four buttons: New Pilot, Continue, Quick Battle, Settings
Continue button disabled if no saved pilot exists
Quick Battle launches combat with preset pilot/mech (for testing)
All buttons keyboard accessible (Tab navigation, Enter to activate)
ARIA labels on all interactive elements
`make test-app` passes
userStories.notes: Implemented title screen with game title, tagline, four buttons. Continue button disabled when no saved pilot exists (checks via API). Quick Battle uses existing demo combat. All buttons have ARIA labels and keyboard navigation. Header hidden on title screen.

userStories.title: Pilot Quarters Hub
userStories.description: Central hub screen showing pilot/mech summary with navigation to missions, loadout, and compendium. This is the main menu after completing pilot creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/quarters` renders hub screen
Displays current pilot name, license level, and mech frame
Navigation buttons: Pilot, Mech, Missions, Compendium
Shows mission count badge on Missions button
Prominent 'Deploy to Mission' button (disabled if no mission selected)
Keyboard navigation between all buttons
Redirects to title if no active pilot
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Mission Select
userStories.description: Display 3 available missions with difficulty rating, SITREP type, terrain, and enemy count. Player selects one to view briefing.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/missions` renders mission list
Shows 3 missions with: name, difficulty stars (1-3), SITREP type, terrain, enemy count
Missions generated statically for MVP (hardcoded 3 missions)
Locked missions (difficulty > pilot level) show lock icon and are non-selectable
Selecting a mission navigates to `/missions/:id/briefing`
Arrow key navigation between mission cards
Back button returns to quarters
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Mission Briefing
userStories.description: Pre-mission screen with narrative briefing, map preview, enemy intel, objectives, and launch button. Static content for MVP.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/missions/:id/briefing` renders briefing screen
Displays mission name, SITREP type, objectives
Shows 2-3 paragraph briefing text (static for MVP)
Enemy intel section: frame types, count, threat assessment
Map preview thumbnail (can be placeholder image)
Loadout check section showing pilot's current mech
Launch Mission button starts combat
Back button returns to mission select
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Mission Debrief
userStories.description: Post-mission screen showing outcome, narrative epilogue, and rewards earned. Static content for MVP.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/missions/:id/debrief` renders debrief screen
Displays mission outcome: VICTORY or DEFEAT
Shows 2-3 paragraph epilogue text (static for MVP)
Rewards section: XP earned, salvage (placeholder values)
Statistics: turns taken, damage dealt, damage received
Continue button returns to quarters
Victory/defeat affects displayed narrative tone
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Adapt Character Detail Views
userStories.description: Create pilot detail and mech loadout views from existing character page components.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/quarters/pilot` shows pilot stats, skills, talents
Route `/quarters/mech` shows mech frame, systems, weapons
Reuses existing character detail components where possible
Read-only for MVP (no editing)
Back button returns to quarters hub
Keyboard accessible
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Settings Screen
userStories.description: Settings screen for audio, voice, display, and accessibility preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Route `/settings` renders settings screen
Audio section: master volume, SFX volume, music volume sliders
Voice section: enable voice input toggle, TTS toggle, voice speed
Display section: theme toggle (light/dark)
Accessibility section: reduced motion toggle, high contrast toggle
Settings persist to localStorage
Back button returns to previous screen
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Combat State Serializer
userStories.description: Create a serializer that converts MechCombatScenario state into a structured, LLM-readable format with all information needed for tactical decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Function `serialize_combat_state(scenario: MechCombatScenario) -> dict` in `llm/src/tactician/state_serializer.py`
Output includes: current actor, all combatants (position, HP, heat, conditions), available actions for current actor
Output includes: terrain/hazards on the map, turn order, round number
Positions use hex coordinates matching the combat grid
Actions include their parameters (targets, ranges, damage predictions)
Unit tests in `llm/tests/tactician/test_state_serializer.py` covering various combat states
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: Tactical System Prompt
userStories.description: Design the system prompt that instructs the LLM how to reason about Lancer tactics by NPC role (striker, defender, artillery, etc).
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt template in `llm/src/tactician/prompts/tactical_system.md`
Prompt explains Lancer combat basics (heat, structure, conditions)
Prompt defines output format: JSON with action type, target, reasoning
Includes few-shot examples of good tactical reasoning
Role-specific tactics: striker (aggressive), defender (protect allies), artillery (range)
Prompt template function in `llm/src/tactician/prompts.py` that fills in combat state
Documentation of prompt design decisions in `llm/src/tactician/README.md`

userStories.title: Action Parser and Validator
userStories.description: Parse LLM output into validated combat actions that can be executed by the combat system.
acceptanceCriteria: Function `parse_llm_action(llm_output: str, available_actions: list) -> Action` in `llm/src/tactician/action_parser.py`
Handles JSON parsing with fallback for malformed output
Validates parsed action against available_actions list
Returns closest valid action if exact match fails (fuzzy matching)
Raises clear error if no valid action can be determined
Unit tests covering: valid JSON, malformed JSON, invalid action, fuzzy matching
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: Tactician Integration
userStories.description: Wire the Tactician class into NPC turn flow with configurable LLM backend and fallback behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Class `Tactician` in `llm/src/tactician/tactician.py`
Method `decide_action(scenario: MechCombatScenario, actor_id: str) -> Action`
Configurable LLM backend (supports Claude API, local Ollama)
Includes retry logic for failed parses (max 3 attempts)
Combat scenario detects when current actor is NPC-controlled
NPC turns call `tactician.decide_action()` instead of waiting for input
Graceful fallback if tactician fails (random valid action)
Can be toggled on/off via combat scenario config
Logs reasoning chain for debugging/display
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: AI Reasoning Display
userStories.description: Show the AI's tactical reasoning in the combat interface so players understand why the AI made its choice.
acceptanceCriteria: API endpoint returns AI reasoning with action result
Combat UI shows reasoning panel/tooltip when AI acts
Reasoning is displayed BEFORE action animation plays
Panel shows: situation assessment, considered options, chosen action, rationale
Can be collapsed/hidden via user preference in settings
Works with existing combat log component
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Multi-Action Turn Planning
userStories.description: AI plans full turns with multiple actions (move + attack, overcharge + attack, etc) rather than single actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Tactician can plan sequences of actions for a full turn
Respects action economy (quick vs full actions)
Considers overcharge trade-offs (heat vs extra action)
Returns ordered list of actions to execute
Combat system executes action sequence atomically
Reasoning includes full turn plan explanation
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: Speech-to-Text Input
userStories.description: Implement speech recognition using Web Speech API with push-to-talk activation and visual feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice module in `app/frontend/src/lib/voice/speech-to-text.ts`
Uses Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition)
Push-to-talk activation via keyboard (default: spacebar when not in input)
Visual indicator showing listening state
Transcription displayed in real-time
Configurable language (default: en-US)
Graceful degradation if API unavailable
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Voice Intent Parser
userStories.description: LLM converts natural voice commands into ActionExecutionInput that the combat system can process.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `llm/src/voice/intent_parser.py`
Function `parse_voice_intent(transcript: str, available_actions: list) -> ActionExecutionInput`
Handles natural phrasings: 'attack the striker with my rifle', 'move to 3,2', 'boost forward'
Context-aware: uses current combat state to resolve ambiguous targets
Returns confidence score with parsed intent
Fallback prompt if intent unclear: 'Did you mean attack with Main Rifle?'
Unit tests with diverse voice command examples
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: Text-to-Speech Narration
userStories.description: Narrate action results, AI turns, and important status changes using browser TTS.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice module in `app/frontend/src/lib/voice/text-to-speech.ts`
Uses Web Speech API (SpeechSynthesis)
Narrates: action results, AI turn announcements, damage/status effects
Configurable voice, speed, and volume
Queue system to prevent overlapping speech
Can be enabled/disabled in settings
Interruption support (new high-priority message cancels queue)
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Voice Combat UI
userStories.description: Combat UI components for voice control: toggle button, listening indicator, transcript display, confirmation dialog.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice toggle button in combat action bar
Listening indicator (pulsing icon) when active
Transcript display showing recognized speech
Confirmation dialog for parsed action: 'Attack Striker with Assault Rifle?'
Accept/reject buttons and voice commands ('yes'/'no')
Error state for unrecognized commands with retry prompt
Keyboard accessible (Tab to toggle, Enter to confirm)
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Voice Navigation
userStories.description: Voice commands for navigating game screens outside of combat.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice commands work on all screens: 'go to missions', 'open settings', 'launch mission'
Parser handles navigation intents separately from combat intents
Commands: 'go to [screen]', 'back', 'select [item]', 'launch', 'read briefing'
'Read briefing' triggers TTS to read mission briefing text
Visual feedback shows recognized navigation command
Works with existing router navigation
`make test-app` passes

userStories.title: Mission Generator Orchestrator
userStories.description: Procedurally generate mission configurations: SITREP type, enemy composition, terrain, and difficulty.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `llm/src/mission/generator.py`
Function `generate_missions(pilot_level: int, count: int = 3) -> list[MissionConfig]`
Selects SITREP type from: Control, Extraction, Gauntlet, Holdout, Recon
Configures enemy composition based on SITREP and difficulty

Returns structured MissionConfig with all combat setup data
Unit tests for mission generation
`make test-llm` passes

userStories.title: Narrative Briefing Generation
userStories.description: LLM generates 2-3 paragraph mission briefing based on SITREP type, terrain, and enemy composition.
acceptanceCriteria: Module `llm/src/mission/narrative.py`
Function `generate_briefing(mission: MissionConfig) -> str`
Prompt template in `llm/src/mission/prompts/briefing.md`
Briefing includes: situation, mission objective, known threats, extraction plan

Consistent with Lancer setting (Union, corporations, etc)

userStories.title: Narrative Debrief Generation
userStories.description: LLM generates mission epilogue based on outcome, statistics, and events that occurred during combat.

Epilogue reflects victory/defeat outcome
Incorporates notable events: kills, near-deaths, objective completion
Tone shifts based on outcome (triumphant vs somber)
2-3 paragraphs in length
`make test-llm` passes
